name: Pen Down
thesis: Raygen’s name is a drawing made by a tiny web plotter, turning his love of building machines into the site’s opening gesture.
interaction: Replay an authored SVG lettering sequence while a mint pen and purple gantry follow the actual drawn path; reduced-motion visitors receive the completed drawing immediately.
why: The portfolio itself becomes a small, playful thing Raygen might make, with warm orange monoline lettering leading into real printer artwork and the Hack Club community.
